name: 侠客行2017
group_note: 侠客行 ("The Story of Hero"), MudOS v21 lineage -- same core codebase family as 110 xkx100 and 111 xkx2000zxb (visible in the shared combatd.lpc/quest.h structure). WASM pass fixed: (1) the identical bad-#include bug already seen on xkx2000zxb: adm/daemons/combatd.lpc's '#include </quest/quest.h>' (absolute-path syntax) doesn't resolve under this driver's include-directory rules -- switched to '#include <quest.h>' and moved it after 'inherit F_DBASE;' to satisfy the resulting global-variable-before-inherit ordering rule (identical fix, applied independently since these are separate archives). (2) A genuine downstream consequence of a corrupted board save file: inherit/misc/bboard.lpc's setup() called restore() unguarded; the specific corrupted save (clone/board/kedian_b's) throws 'Illegal file format' mid-parse, and since restore() was the last statement in setup(), the exception (only caught by a distant outer catch() in the call chain) aborted execution before the CALLER's (kedian_b.lpc's create()) remaining set()/replace_program() calls could run, leaving the board's name/short state broken -- every subsequent look in that room then crashed with 'Bad argument 1 to capitalize(), Got: 0' in feature/name.lpc's short(). Wrapped bboard.lpc's restore() call in catch() (a shared inherit, so this protects every board clone in the mudlib, not just kedian_b's) -- the old board messages for that one corrupted board are unrecoverable, but the room/board object itself now initializes cleanly. No is_chinese()/check_legal_name() bug found -- 小浮侠 (3 characters) was accepted on the first attempt with no fix needed. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (this lib's securityd.lpc genuinely reads WIZLIST at boot, unlike xkx2000zxb's save-file-based mechanism -- confirmed via source before assuming the text-file approach would work; no site-lock gate like xkx2000zxb's valid_wiz_login() either). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> gift-stat accept (y) -> email (id@address format) -> gender (m/f) -> enters world with a full character sheet and working score/look commands (including the previously-crashing board room), zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via 'wizlist' command output showing '目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 3268 .lpc files (3239 written, 29 errors on messy legacy code, 0 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 3 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
